title: Cost Insights heatmap — legend clarity & interactive prototype stakeholder review
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and validate a clear, accessible legend and interactive behaviors for the Cost Insights heatmap tile used in the Console dashboard. This ticket covers visual polish, microinteraction spec, accessibility pass (contrast + color-blind safe palette), and developer handoff artifacts. Goal: remove ambiguity in color-to-cost mapping, enable per-cell drill reveal, and ensure the legend scales for compact and expanded layouts.
acceptance_criteria: Final legend visual matches design tokens and scales across density modes
Color palette meets WCAG AA for normal text contrast or has an accessible alternative legend
Prototype demonstrates hover/focus states, keyboard navigation, and small-screen collapse behavior
Dev-ready spec in Figma with redlines, exported tokens, and an attached accessibility checklist
QA checklist created and linked; no blocking accessibility issues remain
comments: 2026-02-21 | Maya Chen: Initial exploration uploaded. Two legend variants: linear gradient bar vs discrete swatch grid. Notes on trade-offs: gradient easier to scan, swatches make thresholds explicit. Attached prototypes for both.
2026-02-24 | Jason Patel (PM): Prefer explicit swatches for enterprise customers who need clear thresholds. Please add an abbreviated gradient for compact mode.

2026-02-26 | Luis Ortega: Prototype updated with swatch grid, hover tooltip showing exact cost range and sample queries. Added keyboard focus styles and aria labels. Requesting accessibility pass for color-blind users.

2026-03-01 | Accessibility review (Rina Singh): Contrast of mid-range swatches fails WCAG AA for 14px text. Recommendation: increase contrast or supply patterns/labels on hover. Suggested adding optional high-contrast mode toggle.

2026-03-04 | Design sync: Decided to keep discrete swatches as default and add an alternative high-contrast palette that is switchable via Console settings. Also agreed on explicit numeric ranges in tooltip to reduce ambiguity.
2026-03-06 | Engineering (Theo Kim): Need spacing tokens and exact CSS variables for swatches. Asking for exported token file and a small set of React props for tooltip timing and animation easing.
2026-03-08 | Maya Chen: Uploaded redlines and motion spec. Added sample HTML snippet for legend component and recommended ARIA attributes. Motion: 80ms fade + 120ms transform for tooltip entrance.

2026-03-10 | QA (Aisha Roberts): Running prototype exploratory testing. Found issue: keyboard focus order on compact mode jumps to other tiles before legend items. Added reproduction steps and suggested fix to trap focus within heatmap when legend is expanded.
2026-03-11 | Luis Ortega: Addressed QA focus trap in spec, updated keyboard nav to use roving tabindex pattern. Preparing final handoff package for eng sprint-42.

2026-03-12 | Maya Chen: Created final review snapshot and asked stakeholders for comments before formal handoff. Noted remaining follow-ups: performance measurement for tooltip render under high-cardinality datasets, and telemetry naming conventions for interaction events.
review_feedback: Stakeholder (Analytics) - prefer numeric buckets that align to billing thresholds (suggested buckets: < $10, $10–$50, $50–$200, > $200)
Security team - no sensitive data in tooltips; ensure sanitization of any returned sample queries
Support team - include a compact legend help link that explains how cost buckets are derived
Design leadership - motion feels slightly slow on low-latency flows; consider reducing tooltip entrance by 20ms for small devices
next_steps: Finalize high-contrast palette and add toggle mock in Console settings (owner: Maya)
Export token JSON and add code snippet to PR description (owner: Luis)
Eng to implement legend component in sprint-42; include telemetry events: heatmap.legend.open, heatmap.cell.hover (owner: Theo)
QA to validate focus-trap and keyboard nav on compact/expanded breakpoints (owner: Aisha)
Follow-up ticket to measure tooltip render latency under 1k+ cell heatmaps (create after initial rollout)
